message.content:
This editorial illustration features the masthead "TEMPO" in large, translucent white capital letters. Below it, the primary headline reads "SAYONARA IBU KOTA NUSANTARA." A smaller text block follows: "Proyek ibu kota baru terancam mangkrak setelah Presiden Prabowo enggan melanjutkan pembangunan sesuai dengan rencana Jokowi. Anggaran negara habis, kerusakan lingkungan di mana-mana. H.26".

The central figure is a man with a mustache and dark hair wearing a white shirt and dark trousers. He stands upright in a small, brown wooden boat. The boat sits in a narrow, pale blue-grey waterway that winds through a flat, light orange and brown landscape toward a horizon line with silhouetted trees and buildings, including a structure resembling a large bird.

In the foreground, the back of a second man’s head and his right arm are visible. He wears a white shirt and holds a white cloth in his right hand, waving it toward the man in the boat. The background sky is a pale yellow-orange. Additional text at the top reads "Misteri Kematian Arya Daru H.66" and "Main Sunat Dana Transfer Daerah H.76." The bottom right corner contains a date "11-17 AGUSTUS 2025," a price, a barcode, and a QR code.
